violation_type.code_system: Texas Administrative Code, Title 26, Ch. HRC42
violation_type.original_code: HRC42.048(e) - Permit issued is not tran
violation_type.title: HRC42.048(e) - Permit issued is not transferable - Revoked if change of owner or location (26 TAC §HRC42.048(e) - Permit issued is not tran)
violation_type.short_title: HRC42.048(e) - Permit issued is not transferable - Revoked if change of owner or location
violation_type.typical_finding: The permit holder failed to meet all requirements related to the new location and is operating at the new location without being permitted. Per HRC42.048(e)(3)(2). A licensed child-care facility that changes location:  (2)  may not operate at the new location unless the commission approves the new location after the licensed child-care facility meets all requirements related to the new location.

The operation provided care for children at a location that is not permitted.
